name: Color Fidelity Dataset (CFD)
description: CFD is a dataset containing over 1.3 million real and synthetic images with ordered levels of color realism, designed to objectively evaluate color fidelity in realistic-style text-to-image generation. It supports the Color Fidelity Metric (CFM), a multimodal encoder-based metric for perceptual color fidelity, and enables training-free Color Fidelity Refinement (CFR) to improve generation authenticity.
reputation: A very recent niche benchmark for color fidelity in text-to-image generation, with limited community adoption so far.
notes: Addresses bias in evaluation of color fidelity in text-to-image generation with a large-scale dataset and metric.
